targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  l.LEAK_CODE            AS leak_code,        -- 漏洞编号（如 CVE）
  l.LEAK_NAME            AS leak_name,        -- 漏洞名称
  l.LEAK_SEVERITY_V3     AS severity,         -- 严重等级（v3）
  COUNT(*)               AS hit_times,        -- 被命中次数（按扫描历史次数统计）
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.APP_ID) AS affected_app_cnt -- 受影响的应用数
FROM yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_scan_history h
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_dp_relation adr
  ON adr.APP_HISTORY_ID = h.ID
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_dependency_detail dd
  ON dd.ID = adr.DP_DETAIL_ID
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_leak_dp_relation ldr
  ON ldr.DP_DETAIL_ID = dd.ID
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_leak l
  ON l.ID = ldr.LEAK_ID
WHERE h.STATUS = 2                      -- 扫描完成
  -- AND YEAR(h.CREATE_TIME) = 2025
  AND dd.DEL_FLAG = 0
  AND l.DEL_FLAG = 0
GROUP BY l.ID, l.LEAK_CODE, l.LEAK_NAME, l.LEAK_SEVERITY_V3
ORDER BY hit_times DESC
LIMIT 10;      -- Top10 漏洞，可按需改成 5 或 20

panels.title: 命中次数最多的漏洞 TopN

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  d.DP_NAME                       AS dp_name,         -- 依赖名
  dd.DP_VERSION                   AS dp_version,      -- 版本号
  COUNT(*)                        AS hit_times,       -- 在扫描结果中被命中的总次数
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.APP_ID)        AS affected_app_cnt,-- 受影响的应用数
  SUM(dd.LEAK_NUM)                AS total_leak_num   -- 该版本关联的漏洞数（元数据）
FROM yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_scan_history h
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_dp_relation adr
  ON adr.APP_HISTORY_ID = h.ID
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_dependency_detail dd
  ON dd.ID = adr.DP_DETAIL_ID
JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_dependency d
  ON d.ID = dd.DP_ID
WHERE h.STATUS = 2                      -- 扫描完成
  AND YEAR(h.CREATE_TIME) = 2025
  AND dd.DEL_FLAG = 0
  AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0
GROUP BY d.DP_NAMESPACE, d.DP_NAME, dd.DP_VERSION
ORDER BY hit_times DESC
LIMIT 10;    -- Top10 依赖版本

targets.rawSql:
WITH active_users AS (
  /* 系统、子系统、特性、大版本、构建实例、测试管理单的创建人 */
  SELECT DISTINCT s.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.devops_system s
  WHERE s.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(s.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT ss.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.devops_sub_system ss
  WHERE ss.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(ss.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT f.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.devops_feature f
  WHERE f.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(f.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT vm.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.version_management vm
  WHERE vm.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(vm.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.build_instance bi
  WHERE bi.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(bi.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT tm.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_development.test_management tm
  WHERE tm.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(tm.create_time) = 2025

  /* 知识文档：创建 / 评论 / 收藏 */
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT d.user_id AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_knowledge.knowledge_document d
  WHERE d.user_id IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(d.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_knowledge.knowledge_comment c
  WHERE c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(c.create_time) = 2025

  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT uc.user_id AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_knowledge.knowledge_user_collect uc
  WHERE uc.user_id IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(uc.create_time) = 2025

  /* 流水线：创建人 */
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT j.create_by AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_dop_pipeline.devops_jenkins_job j
  WHERE j.create_by IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(j.create_time) = 2025

  /* 流水线：触发人（trigger_user 是用户名，需与 sys_user.username 匹配） */
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id
  FROM yanlian_dop_pipeline.devops_job_build_info b
  JOIN yanlian_app_management.sys_user u
    ON u.username = b.trigger_user
  WHERE b.trigger_user IS NOT NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(b.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(b.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) = 2025
),
all_users AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS cnt
  FROM yanlian_app_management.sys_user u
  WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_users)
  / NULLIF((SELECT cnt FROM all_users), 0) * 100
, 1) AS active_ratio;

targets.rawSql:
WITH high_risk_dp AS (
  -- 所有被标记为高危的依赖版本（通过漏洞关联）
  SELECT DISTINCT dd.ID AS dp_detail_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_dependency_detail dd
  JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_leak_dp_relation ldr
    ON ldr.DP_DETAIL_ID = dd.ID
  JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_leak l
    ON l.ID = ldr.LEAK_ID
  WHERE dd.DEL_FLAG = 0
    AND l.DEL_FLAG = 0
    -- 根据实际枚举值调整，这里假设 v3 等级字段用 HIGH/CRITICAL
    AND l.LEAK_SEVERITY_V3 IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')
),
scanned_high_risk_dp AS (
  -- 本年度扫描中实际命中的高危依赖版本
  SELECT DISTINCT adr.DP_DETAIL_ID AS dp_detail_id
  FROM yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_scan_history h
  JOIN yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_app_dp_relation adr
    ON adr.APP_HISTORY_ID = h.ID
  WHERE YEAR(h.CREATE_TIME) = 2025
    AND h.STATUS = 2      -- 2：扫描完成
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.dp_detail_id)                         AS scanned_high_risk_dp_cnt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.dp_detail_id)                         AS all_high_risk_dp_cnt,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.dp_detail_id) 
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT h.dp_detail_id), 0) * 100, 1
  ) AS coverage_percent
FROM high_risk_dp h
LEFT JOIN scanned_high_risk_dp s
  ON s.dp_detail_id = h.dp_detail_id;

panels.title: 部署频率趋势（今年 vs 去年）

targets.rawSql:
WITH task_cnt AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS c 
  FROM yanlian_devops_code_inspect.scan_task t
),
month_cov AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(
      COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(h.scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), h.scan_time),
      '%Y-%m-01'
    ) AS month_str,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(DISTINCT h.scan_task_id) 
      / NULLIF((SELECT c FROM task_cnt), 0) * 100,
    1) AS coverage
  FROM yanlian_devops_code_inspect.scan_history h
  WHERE h.scan_time IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(h.scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), h.scan_time)) = 2025
  GROUP BY month_str
)
SELECT 
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(month_str, ' 00:00:00')) * 1000 AS time,
  coverage
FROM month_cov
ORDER BY month_str;

panels.title: 可信扫描覆盖应用占比（按业务线）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CASE 
           WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), l.LEAK_RELEASE_TIME) <= 7 THEN '7日内发布'
           WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), l.LEAK_RELEASE_TIME) <= 30 THEN '30日内发布'
           ELSE '更早发布'
         END AS bucket
  FROM yanlian_devops_trustworthy.devops_leak l
  WHERE l.DEL_FLAG = 0
    AND l.LEAK_SEVERITY_V3 IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH')  -- 视你实际存的值而定
) t
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY CASE bucket 
           WHEN '7日内发布' THEN 1
           WHEN '30日内发布' THEN 2
           ELSE 3
         END;
